descriptors.name: grain size
descriptors.physical_meaning: Average diameter of crystalline grains in the microstructure
descriptors.rationale: Fundamental length scale controlling mechanical properties via Hall-Petch relation

representation.notes: Log-normal distribution typical; often averaged from EBSD measurements

quality.loss_reason: Averaging destroys grain size distribution information
quality.notes: Mean obscures bimodal distributions and variance

descriptors.name: grain boundary misorientation
descriptors.physical_meaning: Angular difference in crystallographic orientation between adjacent grains
descriptors.rationale: Determines boundary energy and mobility; distinguishes low/high angle boundaries

representation.notes: Distribution from 0-62.8° for cubic; often uses misorientation angle distribution

descriptors.name: texture intensity
descriptors.physical_meaning: Degree of preferred crystallographic orientation in polycrystalline aggregate
descriptors.rationale: Quantifies anisotropy in mechanical and physical properties

representation.notes: Typically 1-20 MRD; unity indicates random texture

quality.loss_reason: Single scalar loses full orientation distribution function

descriptors.name: dislocation density
descriptors.physical_meaning: Total length of dislocation lines per unit volume
descriptors.rationale: Primary measure of plastic strain; controls work hardening behavior

representation.notes: Range 10^12-10^16 m^-2; measured via XRD or TEM

quality.notes: Well-defined scalar with direct physical correspondence

descriptors.name: precipitate volume fraction
descriptors.physical_meaning: Volumetric proportion of secondary phase particles in matrix
descriptors.rationale: Controls precipitation strengthening and grain boundary pinning mechanisms

representation.notes: Typically 0.001-0.3; measured by image analysis or XRD

quality.loss_reason: Loses precipitate size, morphology, and spatial distribution
quality.notes: Volume fraction alone insufficient for strengthening models

descriptors.name: stacking fault energy
descriptors.physical_meaning: Energy per unit area of stacking faults in crystal lattice
descriptors.rationale: Material property controlling dislocation dissociation and deformation mechanisms

quality.notes: Intrinsic material property with unique value

descriptors.name: grain boundary density
descriptors.physical_meaning: Total grain boundary area per unit volume
descriptors.rationale: Inversely proportional to grain size; affects diffusion pathways

quality.notes: Redundant with grain size for equiaxed grains

descriptors.name: grain aspect ratio
descriptors.physical_meaning: Ratio of longest to shortest grain dimension
descriptors.rationale: Characterizes grain elongation from processing; affects directional properties

representation.notes: Unity for equiaxed; 2-10+ for rolled/extruded materials

quality.notes: Single ratio inadequate for complex grain morphologies

descriptors.name: recrystallization fraction
descriptors.physical_meaning: Volume fraction of newly formed strain-free grains after annealing
descriptors.rationale: Tracks microstructure evolution during thermal processing

representation.notes: Time-dependent; measured via EBSD or optical microscopy

quality.notes: Well-defined fraction with clear physical boundary
